floors.reason: The safety kernel decides what is permitted. Every mutation passes through it (C-07).
The workspace's only exception to forbid(unsafe_code) (ADR-0017), and the seam through which every filesystem mutation is performed.
Identity decides whether the thing acted on at mutation time is the thing that was planned. A wrong answer here defeats every check upstream of it.
Provider trust is an authority boundary: a manifest must never be able to grant itself a capability (C-05).
The Python reference still performs real deletion. It is frozen, not inert.
Policy resolution decides eligibility. It cannot mutate, but it decides what may be.
Release authority: what is cut, and on what evidence.
Classification and scan completeness. An incomplete scan reported as complete is how unknown becomes absent (C-02).
Adapters produce the capability results planning consumes.
